definitions.explanation: The front part of the face below the mouth.
The bone structure that forms the framework of the mouth.

examples.english: He has a beard on his chin.

examples.japanese: {顎|あご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れそうな→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧⟦くらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: I laughed so hard I thought my jaw would dislocate.

notes:
{顎|あご} refers to both the chin and jaw area.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {顎|あご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (pull chin in, good posture)
- {顎|あご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (raise chin, look up/act proudly)
- {顎|あご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (jaw dislocates; figuratively: laugh hard)
- ⟦{顎|あご}{髭|ひげ}→あごひげ：20973_agohige⟧ (chin beard, goatee)
- ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧{顎|あご} (double chin)
